description: Phase 6 bundle-purity cases (2026-09-10), written before any Phase 6 code change: pairwise wording (compare / tab / landscape / overlay / remote / terminal / card / sheet / tree / feed / poster), same-product screen pairs (e-commerce, finance, SaaS, media, healthcare, ERP), the same job across five platforms, small-bundle cases where generic fillers are forbidden, conditional critical concepts, wrong-product and direction dominance, off-platform leakage, literal-token traps. No held-out prompt is copied. New runner keys: forbid_kinds, expect_kinds_any.
